summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 16, 2026, announcing that the last patient has begun dosing in its Phase 2 randomized, placebo-controlled trial of intranasal foralumab in early/mild Alzheimer's disease. The study tests foralumab as monotherapy and combined with lecanemab or donanemab, with endpoints including TSPO-PET neuroinflammation, cognition and amyloid/tau biomarkers. Topline data are anticipated in Q1 2027. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine clinical milestone, not a special situation. Watch enrollment completion and Q1 2027 readout timing.
